title: Common Document Reconstruction Record (CDRR) - text-native vertical slice
description:
Frozen record-keeping contract (lane 02-cdrr-receipts, wave A) for one document run through the text-native pipeline: intake -> preflight -> extract -> plan -> apply -> verify -> dispose. Authority order: inputs/FINAL-RECONCILIATION.md, ASSIGNMENT.md, inputs/MAIN-GLM-SYNTHESIS.md.

Core semantics frozen here:
1. NOT_EXERCISED and ERROR are first-class states. Uncertainty lives in envelope 'status' fields (EXERCISED / NOT_EXERCISED / ERROR); closed-vocabulary enums (rotation, gate ids, operation names, refusal families) stay pure and never carry uncertainty markers. NOT_EXERCISED is never counted as PASS (INV-08).
2. A CDRR for a REFUSED document (which is never extracted) is schema-valid: every section object is REQUIRED and carries status NOT_EXERCISED with an empty records array - empty and NOT_EXERCISED, never missing keys (INV-22, enforced by the root if/then clause).
3. The final disposition (ACCEPT | REVIEW | REFUSE | NOT_VERIFIABLE) is machine-derived only from recorded inputs: document class + per-gate statuses + the fired precedence rule from the frozen disposition spec (lane 01). Report/summary code can never choose ACCEPT; ACCEPT only derives from verification records (INV-20). Run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT is NOT a document disposition; it lives in RECEIPT-SCHEMA.json ExperimentRunReceipt and overrides all document dispositions in the run (INV-23).
4. The CDRR legitimately contains extracted document text (spans, cell strings, bookmark titles); the output-redaction invariant (INV-13) applies to refusal messages and human-readable summaries, not to these evidence records.
5. Schema validity is necessary, not sufficient: a schema-valid ACCEPT example is not a protocol-claim; class-by-gate requirements are frozen in lane 01 DISPOSITION-SPEC.json and consumed by the disposition engine, not restated here.

Gate ids G01-G12 mirror inputs/MAIN-GLM-SYNTHESIS.md verification chain; G12 (human A/B usability) is experiment-closure-level per FINAL-RECONCILIATION correction item 4 and is never part of the per-document mechanical acceptance predicate. The frozen allowed operation set mirrors the Phase 0 tidy set (ten operations; page order, page count and page boundaries immutable).

record_kind.description: Discriminator. Always CDRR for this schema.

schema_version.description: Frozen for this experiment. A bump requires an explicit re-freeze; silently writing a different version is INVALID_EXPERIMENT (INV-24).

cdrr_id.description: Stable identifier of this reconstruction record.

experiment_id.description: Experiment-level identifier shared by all runs of this guarded build.

run_id.description: Per-document run identifier. One run processes exactly one document with private temp state (INV-11).

fixture_id.description: Sealed fixture identifier from lanes/03-fixtures-oracles/FIXTURE-MANIFEST.json. Synthetic sample records use FIX-SYNTH-* ids and contain no real document data.

generated_by.description: Builder tool + version + producing lane (INV-07, INV-14).

original_filename.description: Filename of the sealed input as recorded at intake.

mime_detected.description: MIME detected from bytes, never from extension (frozen intake rule).

byte_size.description: Exact byte size at intake. INV-01: this value and the sha256 must be identical before and after every run and at experiment close.

sha256.description: Immutable source hash of the original file bytes (INV-01).

sealed_fixture_manifest_ref.description: Pointer into the sealed fixture manifest binding this hash to the fixture id (INV-15 provenance).

hash_algorithm.description: Frozen hash algorithm for every hash in this record.

object_count.description: Count of indirect objects in the source as seen by the conservative parser; null when NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR.

inventory_digest.description: sha256 over the serialized per-object inventory (object number, type, byte length). Full inventory lives with the builder artifact; the CDRR carries the digest plus summary (INV-16).

summary.description: Per-object inventory summary (counts by object type). Templated/statistical only - never a dump of document strings (INV-13).

status.description: First-class uncertainty: a crashed classifier is ERROR, a document refused before classification is NOT_EXERCISED.

class_label.description: Document class label. Sized to the text-native slice: classes outside it are recorded as UNSUPPORTED (with refusal_scan.refusal_family giving the precise Phase-0 family). UNKNOWN only with status NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR.

detail.description: Templated reason text plus page/region identifiers only; never raw document text (INV-13).

outcome.description: Phase-0 outcome. REFUSED means the document never enters extraction; its CDRR then has all extraction sections NOT_EXERCISED and empty (INV-22).

refusal_family.description: Required and meaningful only when outcome is REFUSED; NOT_APPLICABLE otherwise.

detail.description: Templated refusal reason family + page/region identifiers; no raw document text (INV-13).

records.description: One record per source page, in source page order. INV-02: candidate page count must equal len(records) (page count invariance). INV-03: MediaBox/CropBox are page boundaries and are immutable. INV-04: this array's order is the immutable page order.

Headings with explicit levels, paragraphs, list items, notices, captions, figures (text-native elements: figures are represented by their text content and bbox anchors only; there is no raster in this slice).

score.description: Numeric confidence in [0,1]; null when NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR.

ordered_element_ids.description: Element ids in the derived reading order. INV-05: any source-vs-candidate reading-order difference must correspond to exactly one planned+applied SET_VERIFIED_READING_ORDER operation; any other reading-order change is a material failure.

records.description: Empty when the document class has no tables or when the section was not exercised. Cell identity is (table_id, row_anchor, column_anchor) where table_id comes from the enclosing TableRecord. Parsed numbers are verification-only and never replace displayed strings.

bookmarks.description: Bookmark/outline entries. INV-18 kill-condition coverage: bookmark loss must be detectable by gate G06.

per_page_anchors.description: Page-level ink coverage anchors consumed by gates G04 (visible/text agreement) and G09 (independent renderer ink accounting). Full bitmaps live in render artifacts, never in the CDRR.

records.description: Every planned operation. INV-15 (frozen operation-set closure): operation_name must be one of the ten frozen allowed operations; anything else is INVALID_EXPERIMENT (condition E15).
What was actually applied, with tool + version. INV-07: the applying tool is a builder-path component, never a verifier component (verifier-never-repairs, INV-06).
Expected-vs-observed delta reconciliation per applied operation (INV-21). The authoritative per-operation receipts are OperationRecords in RECEIPT-SCHEMA.json; this inline copy must agree with them.

One result per gate execution. NOT_EXERCISED and ERROR are first-class statuses; a NOT_EXERCISED gate must carry a reason code and is never counted as PASS (INV-08). The authoritative records are VerifierRecords in RECEIPT-SCHEMA.json; this inline copy must agree with them (INV-24).

final_disposition.description: Mechanically derived document disposition. Run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT is NOT a document disposition; it is recorded in the ExperimentRunReceipt and overrides every document disposition in the run (INV-23).

document_class.description: Echo of classification.class_label - a machine-derivation input.

gate_statuses.description: Echo of the per-gate statuses consumed by the disposition engine (machine-derivation inputs; INV-08 applies to these values verbatim).

required_gate_matrix_version.description: Version/hash of the frozen class-by-gate matrix from lane 01 DISPOSITION-SPEC.json that the engine applied.

fired_precedence_rule_id.description: Identifier of the precedence rule from the frozen disposition spec (lane 01) that decided the outcome.

derived_from_records_only.description: Mechanical declaration that ACCEPT (and every disposition) derives only from verification records and the frozen decision rules; report/summary code has no authority to set it (INV-20).

refusal_family.description: Echo of refusal_scan.refusal_family when final_disposition is REFUSE; null otherwise.

human_confirmation_ref.description: Reference to a human-confirmation record for REVIEW replay, or null. The effect of CONFIRM on replay is frozen in lane 01; this field only anchors it.

then.description: INV-22 refuse-shape completeness: a REFUSED document is never extracted, so every extraction section must be explicitly NOT_EXERCISED (or ERROR, if the refuser crashed mid-write) with empty records - present, never missing.

RefusalFamily.description: Frozen Phase-0 refusal families (templated; refusal messages never echo document text, INV-13/E13).

LooseId.description: Identifier whose exact format is owned by another frozen lane (fixture ids by lane 03, run ids by the integrator).

ToolRef.description: Named tool + version. Versions must be the versions actually used (INV-07/INV-14 provenance).

SectionStatus.description: Envelope status for every CDRR section. NOT_EXERCISED means the pipeline stage never ran (e.g. refused before extraction); ERROR means it ran and failed. NOT_EXERCISED is never counted as success (INV-08).

not_exercised_reason.description: Templated reason when status is NOT_EXERCISED (e.g. REFUSED_BEFORE_EXTRACTION); null otherwise.

RefusedSectionConstraint.description: Applied via root if/then: when final_disposition is REFUSE, extraction sections must carry status NOT_EXERCISED (or ERROR) and empty records arrays (INV-22).

units.description: Canonical PDF points (1/72 inch), device-independent coordinates as emitted by the extractor.

PointBox.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in canonical points. Cross-field orientation checks belong to gate G02, not to this schema.

source_page_hash.description: sha256 over the serialized raw page-object bytes as emitted by the conservative parser; must be reproducible from the immutable source (INV-01/INV-16).

object_count.description: Indirect objects reachable from this page.

unicode_text.description: Unicode text of the span as extracted. (Evidence record: the CDRR stores extracted content by design; INV-13 redaction applies to refusal messages and summaries, not here.)

glyph_mapping_status.description: Glyph-to-unicode mapping status. Material text without a verified glyph mapping is a Phase-0 refusal family; NORMALIZE_TYPOGRAPHY is only allowed over spans with VERIFIED mapping (INV-17).

heading_level.description: Explicit heading level; must be an integer 1..6 when element_type is HEADING (enforced by if/then below), null otherwise.

lexeme.description: Exact numeric substring as displayed (leading zeroes, precision, signs, parentheses, dashes preserved). Parsed values never replace displayed strings.

parsed_value.description: Verification-only parse; null when the lexeme is not machine-parseable. Arithmetic checks detect divergence, they never correct the document.

unit.description: Unit token attached to this lexeme, or null; external declarations live in TableRecord.external_unit_declarations.

row_anchor.description: Stable source-derived row identity anchor (not page order).

column_anchor.description: Stable source-derived column identity anchor (not page order).

displayed_string.description: Exact displayed cell string; preserved verbatim through every allowed operation.

table_id.description: First component of cell identity (table_id, row_anchor, column_anchor).

declaration.description: External unit declaration text (e.g. 'in thousands') anchored to its source element; preserved verbatim.

coordinates.description: Destination point/box in canonical points when kind is XYZ; shape owned by the extractor.

target_independently_established.description: REPAIR_INTERNAL_NAVIGATION may only target a link whose destination was independently established (frozen Phase-0 rule); false targets are out of scope for repair.

ink_coverage_ratio.description: Fraction of page area with visible ink per independent renderer at the frozen resolution.

ink_anchor_digest.description: sha256 over the rendered ink bitmap at the frozen resolution; anchor for visible/text agreement (gates G04/G09).

material_change.description: Must be false for every allowed Phase-0 operation except ROTATE_PAGE, which is REVIEW-only. Declaring a material change inside the automatic path is a protocol violation recorded for the disposition engine.

FrozenOperationName.description: The frozen Phase-0 allowed operation set (inputs/MAIN-GLM-SYNTHESIS.md). No other operation name is valid anywhere in this experiment (INV-15 of INVARIANTS.md); page order, page count and page boundaries are immutable.

justification_note.description: Optional builder note; templated identifiers only, no raw document text (INV-13).

review_only.description: Must be true for ROTATE_PAGE (the only REVIEW-only operation in the frozen set); false for everything else.

tool.description: ToolRef-shaped: name + version of the builder tool that applied the operation (INV-06/INV-07).

observed_delta.description: DeltaObservation-shaped observation of what actually changed; null when not applied.

candidate_artifact_ref.description: Reference to the candidate artifact produced by this application.

reconciliation_status.description: Expected-vs-observed delta outcome per operation (INV-21). DIVERGED on a material delta blocks ACCEPT.

evidence_refs.description: References to verifier evidence (VerifierRecord ids or artifact paths).

GateId.description: Frozen gate ids mirroring the synthesis verification chain. G12 is experiment-closure-level (FINAL-RECONCILIATION correction item 4) and is never part of the per-document mechanical acceptance predicate.

GateStatus.description: Frozen gate statuses. NOT_EXERCISED is a first-class state and is never counted as PASS (INV-08).

NotExercisedReasonCode.description: Frozen reason codes required whenever a gate is NOT_EXERCISED.

IndependenceClass.description: Mechanical independence declaration for the tool that executed a gate. Same-engine extraction and verification do not count as independence (frozen synthesis rule). A decisive gate not declared INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION may not contribute to ACCEPT (INV-07).

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence artifacts (hashes, digests, verifier record ids, artifact paths).

decisive.description: Whether this gate is decisive for the disposition under the frozen class-by-gate matrix.

not_exercised_reason_code.description: Must be one of NotExercisedReasonCode when gate_status is NOT_EXERCISED (if/then below); null otherwise.

x-invariants-registry.description: Cross-reference: every invariant id frozen in INVARIANTS.md (lane 02-cdrr-receipts). Mechanical check methods and violation semantics live in INVARIANTS.md; this registry makes each id findable inside the schema record (checked by validate.py).

invariants.INV-01: Original source byte-immutability: sha256/byte size identical before and after every run (E01).
invariants.INV-02: Page count invariance between source and candidate; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-03: Page boundary invariance: MediaBox/CropBox per page unchanged; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-04: Page order invariance; silent change is E10.
invariants.INV-05: Reading order changed only via a named frozen SET_VERIFIED_READING_ORDER operation.
invariants.INV-06: Verifier never repairs the candidate it evaluates (E03).
invariants.INV-07: Builder/verifier separation points named; decisive gates need INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION.
invariants.INV-09: Receipts written for every run including refusals and crashes (E11).
invariants.INV-10: Outputs written atomically (temp path then rename) (E12).
invariants.INV-11: Private temp lifecycle: per-document, removed, never reused (E07).
invariants.INV-13: All outputs redacted to templated reasons; no document text echoed in refusal messages (E13).
invariants.INV-14: Provenance preservation: every integrated artifact traceable to its lane (E14).
invariants.INV-15: Frozen operation-set closure; any non-frozen operation is E15.
invariants.INV-16: Hash format integrity: every hash field is 64-char lowercase hex and recomputable.
invariants.INV-18: Refusal precision: refusal families recorded with evidence anchors; benign controls not refused.
invariants.INV-19: Determinism: rerun from clean temp reproduces candidate hash modulo declared variable fields.
invariants.INV-20: ACCEPT derives only from verification records; report/summary code can never choose ACCEPT (E05).
invariants.INV-21: Expected-delta reconciliation per applied operation; material divergence blocks ACCEPT.
invariants.INV-22: Refuse-shape completeness: REFUSED CDRR keeps all sections present, NOT_EXERCISED, empty.
invariants.INV-23: Run-level INVALID_EXPERIMENT overrides all document dispositions of the run.
invariants.INV-24: Records are append-only; corrections supersede, never rewrite.
